correctness.rationale: The graph KG(7,3) has 35 vertices indexed by triples of seven points and disjointness edges; Ind(KG(7,3)) simplices are intersecting triple-families. For each of 15 S7 cycle types, an invariant simplex is exactly a union of permutation cycles of triples that are internally and mutually intersecting. Signed oriented simplex traces simplify to -sum_{independent orbit subsets}(-1)^number_orbits; an independently reconstructed exact recursion reproduces all 15 Lefschetz values (22,6,-5,2,4,3,-3,2,0,4,2,-1,1,1,1). The inspected source CHECKS implements Murnaghan–Nakayama for all Specht characters; the virtual representation has +1 each for (7),(4,3),(2,2,2,1), and -1 each for (1^7),(2,1^5), zero otherwise. Feng 2026 supplies independently published rational Betti ranks H6=29, H9=7 and vanishing elsewhere. The -1 terms must be in H9 and dimensions 1+6 exhaust it, forcing H6 to be the positive three Specht summands of dimensions 1+14+14. No unproved integral or higher-parameter claim is inferred.
residual_risks: Uses published Feng 2026 H6/H9 rank theorem; own finite character check does not independently prove that rank theorem.
